## Parallels RAS — Infrastructure Overview

**Workbook build:** `2026.07.03.1`

_Designed and developed by **Silvio Di Benedetto**, CEO at Inside Technologies, Microsoft MVP and Parallels VIPP._

---

This workbook provides full-stack monitoring of a **Parallels RAS 20.x / 21.x** farm connected to Azure Monitor via two independent pipelines:

- **Pipeline A — Windows telemetry (Azure Monitor Agent):** performance counters (CPU, RAM, disk, network, Terminal Services sessions) and Windows Event Log entries are collected by AMA on all farm servers (Azure Arc-enabled) and streamed into the native `Perf` and `Event` tables.
- **Pipeline B — RAS-specific data (PowerShell + Logs Ingestion API):** a scheduled PowerShell script running on the Connection Broker queries the Parallels RAS API every 5 minutes and currently publishes structured JSON payloads to five custom tables: `RASServer_CL` (server inventory and roles), `RASAgent_CL` (agent versions per server), `RASSession_CL` (active RDP sessions), `RASSessionHistory_CL` (session history derived from snapshots), `RASAudit_CL` (administrator sessions and audit events). The deployment also prepares report-grade extension tables for application usage, connection events, devices and user experience.

Credentials are stored in **Azure Key Vault**; the collector authenticates to Azure using the server's **Managed Identity** — no secrets are stored in scripts or Task Scheduler.

**Tabs:**
- **Overview** — KPI tiles (monitored servers, active sessions, error events, distinct agent versions) and a per-server summary with CPU, RAM and recent error count.
- **Events** — Parallels RAS application events only (all providers), filtered from the Windows Event Log by source name.
- **Services & Versions** — server coverage by role, agent version distribution (donut) and full agent inventory grid.
- **Performance** — CPU and RAM time-series charts, split by role: Session Host (RDSH) vs other roles (Broker, Gateway, Provider). Session counter chart for RDSH servers.
- **Sessions** — real-time snapshot of active RDP sessions (last 10 minutes): by state, by host and full session detail table.
- **Reports** — Azure-native replacements for the first RAS Reporting views: usage overview, session activity, published-resource usage and disconnect/reconnect events.
- **Audit** — administrator activity: actions by admin user, events by source, and full audit log grid.

Data sources: `Perf` · `Event` (Azure Monitor Agent) + `RASServer_CL` · `RASAgent_CL` · `RASSession_CL` · `RASSessionHistory_CL` · `RASAudit_CL` (active Logs Ingestion API streams). Prepared extension tables: `RASApplicationUsage_CL` · `RASConnectionEvent_CL` · `RASDevice_CL` · `RASUserExperience_CL`.

parameters.name: Farm
parameters.label: Farm
parameters.query: RASServer_CL | where isnotempty(FarmName) | distinct FarmName | order by FarmName asc

content.query:
union
(RASServer_CL | where Role !in ('RDSGroup','VDITemplate','VDIPool') | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer | summarize v = dcount(Computer) | extend Metric = 'Monitored servers', o = 1),
(RASSession_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(10m) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, SessionId | summarize v = count() | extend Metric = 'Active sessions', o = 2),
(Event | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where (Source startswith 'Parallels' or Source == '2X Remote Application Server') or (Source == 'Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager' and EventID in (21, 23, 24, 25, 40)) | where EventLevelName in ('Error','Critical') | summarize v = count() | extend Metric = 'Error/Critical events', o = 3),
(RASAgent_CL | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer | summarize v = dcount(AgentVersion) | extend Metric = 'Distinct agent versions', o = 4)
| order by o asc
| project Metric, v
content.title: Key indicators
Server details

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where (Source startswith "Parallels" or Source == "2X Remote Application Server") or (Source == "Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager" and EventID in (21, 23, 24, 25, 40))
| summarize Count = count() by EventLevelName
| order by Count desc
content.title: Events by severity

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where (Source startswith "Parallels" or Source == "2X Remote Application Server") or (Source == "Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager" and EventID in (21, 23, 24, 25, 40))
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventLevelName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Event trend over time

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where (Source startswith "Parallels" or Source == "2X Remote Application Server") or (Source == "Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager" and EventID in (21, 23, 24, 25, 40))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventLevelName, EventID, Source, Message = substring(RenderedDescription, 0, 200)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 300
content.title: Recent events

content.query:
RASServer_CL
| where Role !in ('RDSGroup','VDITemplate','VDIPool')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, Role
| summarize Servers = dcount(Computer) by Role
| order by Servers desc

content.query:
RASAgent_CL
| where isnotempty(AgentVersion)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer
| summarize Servers = count() by AgentVersion
| order by Servers desc
content.title: Agent version distribution

content.query:
RASAgent_CL
| where isnotempty(AgentVersion)
| extend NK = tolower(tostring(split(Computer, '.')[0]))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by NK, AgentType
| extend AgentType = case(AgentType == 'PA', 'Connection Broker', AgentType)
| project Computer, SiteName, AgentType, AgentState, AgentVersion, OSVersion
| order by Computer asc
content.title: Installed agents

content.json:
---
### Native Parallels RAS performance counters
Product-level metrics registered by the installed RAS components. These panels are intentionally separate from Windows and Terminal Services health. Connection Broker time counters retain their native value because Parallels does not document their unit.

#### Connection Broker — user experience
Each chart covers one related phase of the client connection pipeline; values are not added together.

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Parallels RAS Connection Broker'
| where CounterName in ('Average time for client connection', 'Average time to start up a request')
| summarize Value = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, CounterName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Client connection and request start — native value

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Parallels RAS Connection Broker'
| where CounterName in ('Average time for user authentication', 'Average time to retrieve user policy')
| summarize Value = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, CounterName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Authentication and policy retrieval — native value

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Parallels RAS Connection Broker'
| where CounterName in ("Average time to retrieve user's published items", 'Average time to retrieve icons')
| summarize Value = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, CounterName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Published items and icon retrieval — native value

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Parallels RAS Connection Broker'
| where CounterName == 'Average time to send client telemetry'
| summarize Value = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Client telemetry (CEP) — native value

content.json:
#### Secure Gateway — capacity and protocol distribution
Connection counters and thread capacity reported directly by the RAS Secure Gateway. The native `Total connections` counter is cumulative, so the chart shows its positive delta per 5-minute interval.

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Parallels RAS Secure Gateway'
| where CounterName == 'Total connections'
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, CounterValue
| sort by Computer asc, TimeGenerated asc
| serialize
| extend PreviousComputer = prev(Computer), PreviousValue = prev(CounterValue)
| extend Delta = iff(Computer == PreviousComputer and CounterValue >= PreviousValue, CounterValue - PreviousValue, 0.0)
| summarize NewConnections = sum(Delta) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: New Gateway connections per 5 min

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Parallels RAS Secure Gateway'
| where CounterName in ('Total threads', 'Idle threads')
| summarize Threads = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, CounterName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Gateway threads — total and idle (native)

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Parallels RAS Secure Gateway'
| where CounterName in ('RDP tunneled sessions', 'RDP SSL tunneled sessions', 'RDP UDP tunneled sessions', 'RDP UDP DTLS tunneled sessions')
| summarize Sessions = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, CounterName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Gateway RDP protocol distribution

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Parallels RAS Secure Gateway'
| where CounterName in ('HTTP connections', 'HTTPS connections', 'HTML5 connections', 'HTML5 SSL connections')
| summarize Connections = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, CounterName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Gateway web protocol distribution

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Parallels RAS Secure Gateway'
| where CounterName in ('Client connections', 'Client SSL connections')
| summarize Connections = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, CounterName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Parallels Client connections

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Parallels RAS Secure Gateway'
| where CounterName == 'Cached sockets'
| summarize Sockets = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Cached sockets — Gateway to Connection Broker

#### RAS RDS Agent — native session view
Session gauges reported by the Parallels agent; kept separate from Windows Terminal Services counters.

content.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Parallels RAS RDS Agent'
| where CounterName in ('Active RDS sessions', 'Disconnected RDS sessions')
| summarize Sessions = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, CounterName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: RAS Agent sessions

content.query:
RASSession_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, SessionId
| summarize Sessions = count() by SessionState
| order by Sessions desc
content.title: Sessions by state

content.query:
RASSession_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, SessionId
| summarize Sessions = count() by Computer
| order by Sessions desc
content.title: Sessions by host

content.query:
RASSession_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, SessionId
| project LogonTime, UserName, Computer, SiteName, ClientName, ClientIP, SessionState, SessionType, PublishedResource, IdleTimeSec
| order by LogonTime desc
content.title: Active sessions

content.json:
### Reporting replacement
Azure-native reporting views built from Log Analytics data collected by this workbook. Session activity uses `RASSessionHistory_CL`, a durable history derived from periodic `RASSession_CL` snapshots. Published-resource usage is still best effort; exact application launch history requires application-level collector data.

parameters.name: ReportUser
parameters.label: User
parameters.query: RASSessionHistory_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(UserName) | distinct UserName | order by UserName asc

parameters.name: ReportServer
parameters.label: Server
parameters.query: RASSessionHistory_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(Computer) | distinct Computer | order by Computer asc

parameters.name: ReportResource
parameters.label: Published resource
parameters.query: RASSessionHistory_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(PublishedResource) | distinct PublishedResource | order by PublishedResource asc

content.query:
let SessionRollup = RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(UserName)
| summarize DurationSec = max(ObservedDurationSec), arg_max(TimeGenerated, UserName, Computer, ClientIP, PublishedResource) by SessionKey;
union
(SessionRollup | summarize v = count() | extend Metric = 'Observed sessions', o = 1),
(SessionRollup | summarize v = dcount(UserName) | extend Metric = 'Users', o = 2),
(SessionRollup | where isnotempty(PublishedResource) | summarize v = dcount(PublishedResource) | extend Metric = 'Published resources', o = 3),
(SessionRollup | summarize v = round(sum(DurationSec) / 3600.0, 1) | extend Metric = 'Observed hours', o = 4)
| order by o asc
| project Metric, v
content.title: Usage indicators

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(UserName)
| summarize DurationSec = max(ObservedDurationSec), arg_max(TimeGenerated, UserName, Computer, ClientIP, PublishedResource) by SessionKey
| summarize Sessions = count(), TotalObservedHours = round(sum(DurationSec) / 3600.0, 2), Hosts = dcount(Computer), Resources = dcount(PublishedResource) by UserName
| top 20 by TotalObservedHours desc
content.title: Top users by observed time

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(PublishedResource)
| summarize DurationSec = max(ObservedDurationSec), arg_max(TimeGenerated, UserName, Computer, ClientIP, PublishedResource) by SessionKey
| summarize Sessions = count(), Users = dcount(UserName), Hosts = dcount(Computer), TotalObservedHours = round(sum(DurationSec) / 3600.0, 2) by PublishedResource
| top 20 by Sessions desc
content.title: Top published resources

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(UserName)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(FirstSeen), LastSeen = max(LastSeen), Events = count(), ObservedDurationSec = max(ObservedDurationSec), arg_max(TimeGenerated, EventType, UserName, Computer, ClientName, ClientIP, SessionState, PublishedResource, SessionId) by SessionKey
| extend ObservedHours = round(ObservedDurationSec / 3600.0, 2)
| project UserName, PublishedResource, Computer, ClientName, ClientIP, SessionState, EventType, FirstSeen, LastSeen, ObservedHours, Events, SessionId
| order by LastSeen desc
| take 500
content.title: Usage detail

content.query:
let SessionEvents = RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(UserName);
union
(SessionEvents | summarize v = dcount(SessionKey) | extend Metric = 'Observed sessions', o = 1),
(SessionEvents | summarize v = dcount(UserName) | extend Metric = 'Users', o = 2),
(SessionEvents | summarize v = dcount(Computer) | extend Metric = 'Hosts', o = 3),
(SessionEvents | where isnotempty(PublishedResource) | summarize v = dcount(PublishedResource) | extend Metric = 'Published resources', o = 4),
(SessionEvents | where EventType in ('StateChanged','EndedInferred') | summarize v = count() | extend Metric = 'Session changes', o = 5)
| order by o asc
| project Metric, v
content.title: Report indicators

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(UserName)
| where EventType in ('Started','StateChanged','EndedInferred')
| summarize Events = count() by bin(EventTime, 1h), EventType
| order by EventTime asc
content.title: Session activity trend

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(UserName)
| summarize Sessions = dcount(SessionKey), Hosts = dcount(Computer), Clients = dcount(ClientIP), MaxObservedMinutes = round(max(ObservedDurationSec) / 60.0, 1) by UserName
| top 15 by Sessions desc
content.title: Top users by observed sessions

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(UserName)
| where 'value::all' in ({ReportUser}) or UserName in ({ReportUser})
| summarize Sessions = dcount(SessionKey) by bin(EventTime, 1h), UserName
| order by EventTime asc
content.title: Session activity for selected user

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(UserName)
| where 'value::all' in ({ReportUser}) or UserName in ({ReportUser})
| summarize Sessions = dcount(SessionKey), Clients = dcount(ClientIP), Resources = dcount(PublishedResource), MaxObservedMinutes = round(max(ObservedDurationSec) / 60.0, 1) by Computer
| order by Sessions desc
content.title: Hosts used by selected user

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(UserName)
| where 'value::all' in ({ReportUser}) or UserName in ({ReportUser})
| summarize FirstSeen = min(FirstSeen), LastSeen = max(LastSeen), Events = count(), ObservedDurationSec = max(ObservedDurationSec), arg_max(TimeGenerated, EventType, UserName, Computer, ClientName, ClientIP, SessionState, PreviousSessionState, SessionType, PublishedResource, IdleTimeSec, SessionId) by SessionKey
| extend ObservedDuration = LastSeen - FirstSeen
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, ObservedDuration, Events, EventType, UserName, Computer, ClientName, ClientIP, SessionState, PreviousSessionState, SessionType, PublishedResource, IdleTimeSec, SessionId
| order by LastSeen desc
content.title: Session detail for selected user

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(Computer)
| where 'value::all' in ({ReportServer}) or Computer in ({ReportServer})
| summarize Sessions = dcount(SessionKey) by bin(EventTime, 1h), Computer
| order by EventTime asc
content.title: Session activity for selected host

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(Computer)
| where 'value::all' in ({ReportServer}) or Computer in ({ReportServer})
| summarize Sessions = dcount(SessionKey), Clients = dcount(ClientIP), Resources = dcount(PublishedResource), MaxObservedMinutes = round(max(ObservedDurationSec) / 60.0, 1) by UserName
| top 20 by Sessions desc
content.title: Users on selected host

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(Computer)
| where 'value::all' in ({ReportServer}) or Computer in ({ReportServer})
| summarize FirstSeen = min(FirstSeen), LastSeen = max(LastSeen), Events = count(), ObservedDurationSec = max(ObservedDurationSec), arg_max(TimeGenerated, EventType, UserName, Computer, ClientName, ClientIP, SessionState, PreviousSessionState, SessionType, PublishedResource, IdleTimeSec, SessionId) by SessionKey
| extend ObservedDuration = LastSeen - FirstSeen
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, ObservedDuration, Events, EventType, UserName, Computer, ClientName, ClientIP, SessionState, PreviousSessionState, SessionType, PublishedResource, IdleTimeSec, SessionId
| order by LastSeen desc
content.title: Session detail for selected host

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(PublishedResource)
| where 'value::all' in ({ReportResource}) or PublishedResource in ({ReportResource})
| summarize LaunchesApprox = dcount(SessionKey), Users = dcount(UserName), Hosts = dcount(Computer), FirstSeen = min(FirstSeen), LastSeen = max(LastSeen), MaxObservedMinutes = round(max(ObservedDurationSec) / 60.0, 1) by PublishedResource
| top 20 by LaunchesApprox desc
content.title: Published resource usage

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(PublishedResource)
| where 'value::all' in ({ReportResource}) or PublishedResource in ({ReportResource})
| summarize FirstSeen = min(FirstSeen), LastSeen = max(LastSeen), Events = count(), ObservedDurationSec = max(ObservedDurationSec), arg_max(TimeGenerated, EventType, UserName, Computer, ClientName, ClientIP, SessionState, SessionType, IdleTimeSec, SessionId) by PublishedResource, SessionKey
| extend ObservedDuration = LastSeen - FirstSeen
| project PublishedResource, UserName, Computer, ClientName, ClientIP, SessionState, EventType, FirstSeen, LastSeen, ObservedDuration, Events, SessionId
| order by LastSeen desc
content.title: Published resource activity detail

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Source == 'Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager'
| where EventID in (21, 23, 24, 25, 40)
| extend EventType = case(EventID == 21, 'Logon', EventID == 23, 'Logoff', EventID == 24, 'Disconnect', EventID == 25, 'Reconnect', EventID == 40, 'Disconnect reason', 'Other')
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventType
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Logon, logoff and disconnect events

content.query:
RASSessionHistory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(UserName)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(FirstSeen), LastSeen = max(LastSeen), Events = count(), ObservedDurationSec = max(ObservedDurationSec), arg_max(TimeGenerated, EventType, UserName, Computer, ClientName, ClientIP, SessionState, PreviousSessionState, SessionType, PublishedResource, IdleTimeSec, SessionId) by SessionKey
| extend ObservedDuration = LastSeen - FirstSeen
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, ObservedDuration, Events, EventType, UserName, Computer, ClientName, ClientIP, SessionState, PreviousSessionState, SessionType, PublishedResource, IdleTimeSec, SessionId
| order by LastSeen desc
content.title: Session activity detail

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Source == 'Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager'
| where EventID in (24, 25, 40)
| extend EventType = case(EventID == 24, 'Disconnect', EventID == 25, 'Reconnect', EventID == 40, 'Disconnect reason', 'Other')
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventType, EventID, Message = substring(RenderedDescription, 0, 300)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 300
content.title: Disconnect / reconnect events

content.query:
RASAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Actions = count() by AdminUser
| order by Actions desc
| take 15
content.title: Activity by administrator

content.query:
RASAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by Source
| order by Count desc
content.title: Audit events by source

content.query:
RASAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project TimeGenerated, AdminUser, Action, ObjectType, ObjectName, Result, ClientIP, Source
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 300
content.title: Administrator / operator audit log

content.json: > **Note:** Detailed configuration change audit resides in the **RAS Reporting DB**. This view shows admin sessions collected via PowerShell + Connection Broker events from the Windows channel.
